name: CoherentRaster
definition: A real-time 3DGS-based light field rendering framework for Light Field Displays (LFDs) that leverages subpixel-level rasterization for high-resolution multi-view rendering.
summary: CoherentRaster is a real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for light field displays that eliminates redundant cross-view computation and uncoalesced memory access through attribute reuse and remapping.
